kind: Concrete proposed one-time delivery inspection exception; NOT approved or executed
existing_restriction: The approved TODO forbids reading/listing/stat/hash/traversal/mount of private paths, and permits only positive public inspection. No exception has been inferred.
why_needed: The required unmodified canonical todo_diff_expectation_guard.py enumerates real tracked and non-ignored untracked differences for all four declared repositories. It has no positive-pathspec/private-prune argument. A public-only inventory cannot truthfully substitute for that guard.

proposed_exception.purpose: One-time canonical delivery diff inspection, after the functional candidate and reviewable evidence are complete.
proposed_exception.scope: Only operations the canonical guard and its Git subprocesses require for declared root/api/web/foundation repository baselines.
proposed_exception.private_access: May enumerate/stat private paths and internally read/hash tracked file bytes as Git requires to compare changes or detect renames. No private file content is printed or published.
proposed_exception.mutations: None: no private-file edits/deletes, Git staging/commit, topology changes or service/provider changes are authorized by this exception.
proposed_exception.raw_result_destination: Restricted local /tmp files, mode0600; do not commit raw stdout/JSON or private filenames.
proposed_exception.public_receipt: Tool-source hash, exact canonical arguments, terminal exit/outcome, counts and stable violation codes only. No private path values or content.
proposed_exception.on_failure: Classify and report the guard failure; do not erase private files, silently filter violations, edit Delphi or claim GO.
proposed_exception.scope_lifetime: One completed canonical guard run and redacted collection; follow-up private inspection requires its own established authority.

approval_handling: Present the concrete candidate and this exact exception to the user before any private inspection. If explicitly approved, record the limited exception in the governing TODO and re-run normal authority before executing. No implementation scope, DoD or classifier weakening is proposed.
current_status: Proposal only. Implementation and positively bounded test work continue. Full diff-guard GO remains absent.
